rules: Any designated finger exactly all-zero: exclude trial. First5 stage1-3,6-9,13-15; first3 stage10; first2 stage11-12.
Any designated finger count(0<F<=0.5)/count(F!=0)>=0.8: exclude trial.
Any of ALL FIVE fingers exactly equal positive value for >=2000 consecutive samples: exclude trial.
Any of ALL FIVE raw force points >60N: exclude trial.
Any of ALL FIVE initial[0,5)s channels: zero not among exact modes: exclude trial; ties containing0 retained.
semantics: Sequential first-hit reasons only. Raw force, no masks/calibration; no modifications or copies of original data. Existing train/val membership preserved. val_legacy not processed. Errors block complete status; not classified as valid or rule exclusions.
